name: Village Tavern
description: A village inn with a taproom, working kitchen, simple provisions and a stable yard. The daily menu is selected from the wider catalogue.

alwaysStocks: Small Ale and House Hopped Beer
Horse Feed for the stable yard
oftenStocks: A changing selection of pies, supper plates and carved roasts
Other local brews, mead and table wine
Packed meals, snacks and small desserts
Practical shared supplies when the innkeeper can spare them
rarelyStocks: Aged cellar drinks and imported spirits
Luxury meals, game and celebration orders

name: Village General Store
description: Practical household goods, travelling supplies and containers for a small settlement.

name: Village Alchemist
description: A modest workshop supplying common reagents and prepared remedies.

name: Village Blacksmith
description: A working forge focused on repairs, fittings and practical ironwork.

name: Discreet Fence
description: An irregular contact whose stock depends on recent opportunities and trusted introductions.

alwaysStocks: Small second-hand valuables of uncertain provenance
